[#ffffff[]]WE'LL SEE YOU ON THE [#EBE161[]]FLIP[#ffffff[]][#C46BE3[]]SIDE[#ffffff[]]!

[#ffffff[]]Version 2.15 introduces 2 new materials called [#EBE161[]]Valkium [#ffffff[]]& [#C46BE3[]]Domium[#ffffff[]].
2 materials for supporting purposes made from converting [#FF5959[]]swordium[#ffffff[]] for both materials or with [#861C00[]]firebrandium[#ffffff[]] for individual conversion.

[#ffffff[]]A mod about [#ff5959[]]sword [#ffffff[]]& the 7 sword deities from PHIGHTING!
[grey[]](along with 3 characters related to the swords)

[#ffffff[]]Create [#ff5959[]]swordium [#ffffff[]]& convert it into either [#70AC30[]]darkheartium[#ffffff[]], [#861C00[]]firebrandium[#ffffff[]], [#C2C2C2[]]ghostwalkerium[#ffffff[]], [#97CCE1[]]icedaggerium[#ffffff[]], [#E2BAF5[]]illuminaium[#ffffff[]], [#A4C360[]]venomshankium [#ffffff[]]or [#929EAE[]]windforceium[#ffffff[]]!

[#ffffff[]]There's multiple types of turrets, production buildings, units & even a mobile core that you can place down anywhere!

What's special about this mod is that it can be utilized in either erekir, serpulo or any planet mod.
[grey[]]provided that the sector doesn't have restricted blocks.
[grey[]]also note that researching PHIGHTING [#ff5959[]]SWORD [grey[]]DEITIES requires the materials to be on serpulo.
  
[red[]]note: this mod can be considered as unfair to some, but then again, play it your own way!
